attributes.board_name: Hawaii Board of Speech Pathology and Audiology (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

rules.notes: No continuing education is required for renewal (Board FAQ). All Speech Pathologist and Audiologist licenses expire December 31 of each odd-numbered year and are renewed biennially with the fee only; the current period runs Jan 1, 2026 to Dec 31, 2027. Hawaii has no inactive status and does not license speech-language pathology assistants. ASHA certification maintenance is separate and not a state requirement.
rules.rule_quote: 8. Are there continuing education (CE) requirements for licensure renewal? No, there are no CE requirements for renewal.
